documentation.method: Official documentation search followed by bounded page reads
adopted: Apps and deployment slots within the same plan share plan compute.
Per-app placement does not create extra plan capacity or independent compute.
Separate plans isolate compute pools and have their own plan-level billing.
Available slots and capabilities depend on a supporting plan.
notInferred: Independent dependency, regional or platform fault domains

documentation.method: Official documentation search followed by bounded swap-lifecycle page read
adopted: Native swaps can restart source instances and recycle former-production workers.
Old slot content retention does not prevent abandonment of in-flight work during recycling.
HTTP success alone does not establish meaningful readiness.
Routing allocations and pinned clients require actual journey observations.
Native auto-swap is unsupported for Linux code and Web App for Containers.

hostingLimits: This lesson selects no actual OS, SKU, region, subscription, resource group, host or deployment target.
Production Node.js 24 / Express / App Service Linux remains a proposed design, not validation.
External routing permits separate admission, drain and retirement decisions; it cannot eliminate platform restarts.
Both fictional placements deliberately share dependency DATA; separate plans do not certify independent dependencies or fault domains.
